correctness.rationale: For n>=5 the unordered two-particle deleted cubical model of Cn square K2 is an equivariant deformation retract under the standard subdivision hypotheses. Its explicitly oriented 0-,1-,2-cells yield a signed Lefschetz trace. Planar disjoint facial-cycle products span H2 with cap-swap sign and signed nonadjacent rim-face exterior module; the diagonal ±1 minor establishes their primitive integral independence and the cited planar rank identifies the full H2. Character arithmetic recovers H1=epsilon tensor face permutation and the three quotient invariant dimensions. An independently written exact finite cell-permutation trace check agreed for all 180 symmetry elements at n=5..10. The general proof uses facial topology, signed trace identities and planar homology input, not finite extrapolation.
residual_risks: The integral spanning argument depends on the planar face-pair rank theorem and the exact interaction of torus generators; no new complete integral boundary-matrix reduction for arbitrary n.
